messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to flip the new precision profile flag for the rewrite model to int8 in canary 1 (5%). Need sign-off on metrics + rollback windows.
jon: @maria can you confirm the canary audience? 5% infra, or user-sliced? we should avoid power-users.
maria: user-sliced. 5% random by account_id. exclude enterprise tags. config snippet:
```
FLAG: model_precision_profile = "int8_canary"
AUDIENCE: { "pct": 5, "by": "account_id", "exclude_labels": ["enterprise"] }
ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT: 30m
```
ash: pls add latency SLO alert threshold. last smoketest looked +20ms p95 on long prompts.
taylor: noted. proposed SLO check: p95 delta <= +10ms and error-rate delta <= +0.2% over baseline. otherwise auto-roll back.
samir: do we have KV-cache warm-up for int8? cold starts showed higher token cost.
maria: KV warm-up enabled for the canary nodes. I'll attach the rollout plan in GH PR.
jon: who owns the canary cutoff? me and @ash on-call for first hour.
devops-bot: deploy pipeline queued: ref/gh/pr/5123 -> canary_cluster (5%)
ash: also add a quick eval: 200 prompts with the prompt-set 'safety-regressions-v2' and BLEU/rep score checks. abort if mean rep_score drops > 1.5 points.
maria: added that to the PR: run-evals step. command: `./scripts/run_evals --set safety-regressions-v2 --target 200`
taylor: I'll wire up observability: per-model token-cost + per-route latency, and create a dashboard. will add alert binder to the rollout PR.
samir: if we see p95 jump but p50 stable, don't panic — could be a batching artifact. keep open for 30m and monitor.
maria: OK — plan summary: 5% user-sliced canary, int8 profile, KV warm-up, SLOs p95 <= +10ms, error <= +0.2%, evals run, owner jon/ash first-hour. Rollback window 30m auto. Going to flip at 14:00 UTC. Any objections?
jon: no objections from me :thumbsup:
ash: good to go from infra side.
taylor: dashboard ready.
samir: :+1: monitoring on my end.
maria: thanks all — I'll post PR link and timestamp when flip is scheduled.
